provenance.server: Stalwart v0.16 dev rig (docker stalwart-dev behind caldav-test-proxy nginx), http://localhost:8090/dav/
provenance.invariant: A timed weekly series is TZID-anchored with a VTIMEZONE carried in the same object: DTSTART;TZID=Europe/Paris at the 09:00 wall clock, and the Intl-derived two-rule VTIMEZONE (DAYLIGHT + STANDARD, ordinal-weekday RRULEs). This is the component PR3 replaces with the ical4j registry.
